Definition: from G575 and G142; to lift off, i.e. remove:--take (away).
BiblicalUsage: When the bridegroom is taken away, then shall the disciples fast, Jesus says, and the bridegroom's friends cannot mourn while He is with them. The word is the lifting off, the taking away of the one whose presence made the feast.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for taking away carries no doctrine of its own; its sorrow is the disciples', that the Bridegroom would one day be taken from them.
